```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(easyNIS)
library(dplyr)
library(srvyr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```


## Match diagnosis and procedure codes

```{r flags}
nis <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019:2020)) |>
  nis_flag_dx(
    heart_failure = list(prefix = "I50", regex = "^I50[0-9]+$", exclude = "I509")
  ) |>
  nis_flag_dx(principal_hf = "I50", position = "principal") |>
  nis_flag_pr(pci = "0270")

nis |> count(heart_failure, principal_hf, pci) |> collect()
```

The default position checks all slots. Use `position = "principal"` for
slot 1. A prefix or full-code regular expression can set a flag. Exclusions
apply to individual matching codes, so another slot can still set the flag.

```{r mixed}
nis_open(nis_example(years = 2015)) |>
  nis_flag_dx(hf = list(icd9 = "428", icd10 = "I50"), system = "both") |>
  count(DQTR, hf) |>
  collect()
```

Supply separate definitions for each system when the source contains both
slot sets. Check how the code sets behave around the transition.
[Years and coding eras](years-and-eras.html)

## Use CCSR categories or procedure days

```{r categories-timing}
nis |>
  nis_add_ccsr(position = "default", version = "2025.1") |>
  count(ccsr) |>
  collect()

timing <- nis |> mutate(PRDAY1 = 0L, PRDAY2 = 1L)
nis_audit_prday(timing, pr = "0270")
timing |>
  nis_flag_pr_timing(
    index_pr = list(prefix = "0270", exclude = "02703DZ"),
    outcome_pr = list(regex = "02L73.*"),
    relation = "after", missing_day = "indeterminate"
  ) |>
  count(outcome_post_index) |>
  collect()
```

CCSR groups ICD-10 codes. The bundled v2025.1 mappings can keep the same
definitions across study years. `position = "default"` returns one
inpatient category for the principal diagnosis. The example supplies
invented procedure days. Timing uses the earliest known index day and
accepts the same prefixes, full-code regular expressions, and exact
exclusions as `nis_flag_pr()`. For `system = "both"`, supply named
`icd9` and `icd10` definitions for each procedure. Timing compares
slots within the same code system. Audit procedure-day availability
before interpreting an order.

## Count eligibility steps and save the cohort

```{r flow}
flow <- nis_attrition(
  nis, adult = AGE >= 18, hf = heart_failure, by_year = TRUE, .design = TRUE
)
flow

eligible <- nis_attrition_cohort(flow)
export <- nis |> mutate(stayDays = LOS)
path <- nis_write_cohort(export, !!eligible, tempfile(), keep = c(AGE, stayDays))
design <- nis_design(nis_open(path), keep = stayDays)
summarise(design, total = survey_total(), mean_stay = survey_mean(stayDays))
```

The flow counts remaining discharges after each criterion. The saved Parquet
cohort retains the hospital structure used for variance. Open it without
supplying a new `cohort` to `nis_design()`. Derived names such as
`stayDays` keep their spelling when you reopen the saved cohort. Keep
the code that defined your flags with the study.
